summary: Implemented focused orbit render stabilization: no-write discard captures now warm the camera/render state before frame_0000 is written, deterministic capture metadata is based on verified property readback, and scene-off renders now include a flashlight-off diagnostic plus best-effort environment contributor disabling.
work_completed: Added reusable discard warm-up capture path after camera sensor setup and after each light-setting change, so initial unstable captures are read and dropped instead of written as frame_0000.
Refactored orbit frame capture to share the same explicit capture path for warm-up and written frames.
Made bAlwaysPersistRenderingState disabling robust across Unreal Python property spellings and truthful by recording readback attempts; metadata now reports disabled only when verified.

Added best-effort scene-off disabling for environment contributors such as sky light, fog, sky atmosphere, volumetric cloud, reflection capture, and post-process components, with metadata counts under scene_light_state.environment_contributors.
Added scene_off_flashlight_off to the default orbit light settings as a diagnostic control for baked/static/environment illumination with the flashlight disabled.
Updated orbit workflow docs and README to describe the four-condition render set, scene-off diagnostic purpose, warm deterministic capture behavior, and environment contributor disabling.
